briefdescription.para: To innovatively identify the dependencies between MIs across two trips, we construct a DAG for a new MBB, which is created by copying the original MBB three times.

detaileddescription.para: We refer to this new MBB as 'TripleMBB' and the corresponding DAG as 'TripleDAG'. If the dependencies are more than two trips, we avoid applying window algorithm by identifying successive phis in the old MBB.

briefdescription.para: OriMIs keeps the MIs removed from the original MBB.
TriMIs keeps the MIs of TripleMBB, which is used to restore TripleMBB.
TriToOri keeps the mappings between the MI clones in TripleMBB and their original MI.
OriToCycle keeps the mappings between the original MI and its issue cycle.
